title: Irrigation Valve Stuck-Open Detection
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), water pressure (`waterpressure:reading`), irrigation control (`irrigation:zone`), water-heater events (`waterheater:event`), greywater tanks (`greywater:tank`), and utility sensors for pumps and softeners (`sumppump:event`, `wellpump:event`, `watersoftener:status`).
app: Water and plumbing telemetry from smart water meters, pressure sensors, irrigation controllers, sump and well pumps, greywater tanks, and water-heater sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=irrigation:zone
| stats latest(runtime_min) as runtime_min latest(target_runtime_min) as target_runtime_min by zone
| where runtime_min>target_runtime_min*1.5
description: Flags irrigation zones that ran far longer than planned, which often indicates a stuck valve or scheduler issue.
value: A single irrigation fault can waste a large amount of water quickly, so runtime overrun is worth monitoring directly.
implementation: Collect target and actual runtimes from the irrigation controller after every watering cycle.
visualization: Table of irrigation zones exceeding planned runtime.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which sprinkler zones kept running much longer than planned, so you can stop water waste quickly.
